description_en: Queries the back-to-origin policies for the forwarding rule of a website
description_zh: 查询网站业务转发规则的回源策略
name: DescribeL7RsPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website to query.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query the domain names for which forwarding rules are configured
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网站业务的域名。

域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of N addresses of origin servers to query. The maximum value of N is 200. You can specify up to 200 addresses
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的源站服务器地址列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个源站服务器地址
parameters.name: real_servers

Attributes.description_en: The details about the parameters for back-to-origin settings

ConnectTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for a new connection. Valid values: 1 to 10. Unit: seconds. Default value: 5
ConnectTimeout.description_zh:
新建连接超时时间。
值范围1~10秒，默认值为5

FailTimeout.description_en: The expiration time of a connection, in seconds. If the number of failures at the origin server exceeds the MaxFails value, the address of the origin server is set to down and the expiration time is FailTimeout. The final value is the maximum value of ConnectTimeout and FailTimeout. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Unit: seconds. Default value: 10
FailTimeout.description_zh:
失效时间，单位秒，当源站失败超过MaxFails时，则将该源站地址设置为down，时效为FailTimeout时间，最终取值取ConnectTimeout和FailTimeout的最大值。
值范围1~3600秒，默认值为10

MaxFails.description_en: The maximum number of failures. This parameter is related to health check. Valid values: 1 to 10. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3
MaxFails.description_zh:
最大失败次数，健康检查相关。
值范围1~10秒，默认值为3

Mode.description_en:
The primary/secondary flag. Valid values:

active: primary

backup: secondary
Mode.description_zh:
主备属性标志。取值：

active：主。
backup：备

ReadTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for a read connection. Valid values: 10 to 300. Unit: seconds. Default value: 120
ReadTimeout.description_zh:
读连接超时时间。
取值范围10~300秒，默认值为120

SendTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for a write connection. Valid values: 10 to 300. Unit: seconds. Default value: 120
SendTimeout.description_zh:
写连接超时时间。
取值范围10~300秒，默认值为120

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the origin server. This parameter takes effect only if the value of ProxyMode is rr or ip_hash.\\

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100. A server with a higher weight receives more requests
Weight.description_zh:
服务器的权重。仅在使用轮询算法（ProxyMode为rr）和IP Hash算法（ProxyMode为ip_hash）时生效。

权重取值范围：1~100，默认值为100。权重越高的服务器分配到的请求越多

RealServer.description_en: The address of the origin server

RsType.description_en:
The address type of the origin server. Valid values:

0: IP address

1: domain name
RsType.description_zh:
源站服务器的地址类型。取值：

0：表示源站服务器的IP地址。
1：表示源站服务器的域名地址

ProxyMode.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm for back-to-origin traffic. Valid values:

ip_hash: the IP hash algorithm. This algorithm is used to redirect the requests from the same IP address to the same origin server.

rr: the round-robin algorithm. This algorithm is used to redirect requests to origin servers in turn.

least_time: the least response time algorithm. This algorithm is used to minimize the latency when requests are forwarded from Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to origin servers based on the intelligent DNS resolution feature
ProxyMode.description_zh:
回源负载均衡算法。取值：

ip_hash：表示IP Hash算法。根据请求来源IP进行HASH映射，将同一个IP的所有请求定向到一个源站服务器。
rr：表示轮询算法。将所有请求轮流分配给不同源站服务器。
least_time：表示Least Time算法。该算法通过智能DNS解析能力，保证业务流量从接入防护节点到转发回源站服务器整个链路的时延最短

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RsAttrRwTimeoutMax.description_en: The timeout period for a read or write connection
RsAttrRwTimeoutMax.description_zh: 当前用户读/写连接超时时间上限值

UpstreamRetry.description_en:
The back-to-origin retry switch. Valid values:

1: on

0: off
UpstreamRetry.description_zh:
回源重试开关。取值：

1：打开。
0：关闭
